M5: capacitor adapter uses getUnifiedTracking() shared singleton instead of new UnifiedTrackingCore() so plugin/hooks/main entry share one core (init+providers+listeners are per-instance). subTasks.title: Batch 7.6 EventQueue (H5+M11): WIRED UP - pre-init buffering + drain-replay on init + M11 dedupe fix
subTasks.note: User chose option A. H5: the 6 dispatch methods (track/identify/logScreenView/logRevenue/setUserProperties/logError) now buffer via eventQueue.add() when called before initialize() resolves (validation still runs first) instead of throwing; initialize() calls replayQueuedEvents() which drains the queue and replays in FIFO order through the now-ready providers. Added EventQueue.drain(). RUNTIME-PROVEN: track+identify before init -> queue size 2; after init -> 0 (drained+replayed). M11: flush() now re-queues a failed batch ONCE (was once per rejected listener -> duplicates), preserving order + honoring maxRetries; documented the listener-idempotency contract for the broadcast model. Removed the now-unused ensureInitialized() (buffering replaced the throw-if-not-init behavior). Note: persisted pre-init events are best-effort for plain-data events; Error objects don't serialize across reload (documented). Decision: did NOT add post-init periodic batching - provider SDKs already batch; library-level batching would change send timing surprisingly (documented in phase08). Gate green + ESM smoke + proof.
